title: Nvidia: reported SEC accounting inquiry and CEO turmoil
what_happened: Nvidia announced on 2026-11-12 that Jensen Huang had resigned as CEO, and on 2026-11-23 that the board had reinstated him. The company refers to ongoing government investigations and inquiries without naming an agency. Press reports of an SEC probe have not been confirmed by the company or the SEC.
how_it_reaches_markets: Nvidia's index weight and its role as a bellwether for AI demand; uncertainty about reported results; possible chip-export restrictions.

sourced_facts.text: 2026-11-12: Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang 'has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately'; no reason is stated; CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO
2026-11-23: the board reinstated Huang as President, CEO and director, effective immediately

The 2026-11-23 release refers to 'ongoing government investigations and inquiries' without naming an agency, and to a committee review after reporting that Mr. Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort
The company's 8-K of 2026-11-17 (quarterly results) does not mention an SEC inquiry

resolved_when_all: The SEC inquiry is publicly closed without enforcement action, or settled with terms disclosed
Nvidia files its next periodic report on time with no restatement of prior results
worsened_when_any: Nvidia announces a restatement or delays a periodic filing
The SEC or DOJ announces formal charges

relief_headlines_that_do_not_resolve_it: The CEO's return: the reported accounting inquiry is unchanged by it (press described the return as a temporary reprieve)

history.note: Card opened. Resolution conditions written before the outcome is known.

Sources upgraded and a correction recorded. Huang's reinstatement on 2026-11-23 is confirmed by the company's SEC-filed release. The original statement that Reuters reported on 2026-11-20 an SEC investigation of accounting practices is not confirmed as written: the wire text read says the WSJ reported an SEC probe on 2026-11-17 and does not state its subject. what_happened is left as first written; read it with this note.
Second pass. The resignation of 2026-11-12 was confirmed on the company's SEC-filed release. The 8-K of 2026-11-17 does not mention an SEC inquiry.

Summary rewritten so that it states only what was confirmed at the listed sources and marks the rest as reported. The first version is kept under superseded_sources. Resolution conditions are unchanged.

note: Risk state only. Not a forecast and not investment advice.
unconfirmed_facts: SEC probe: a Reuters dispatch dated 2026-11-17 says the Wall Street Journal reported the SEC is probing Nvidia after Huang's resignation. It does not say the probe concerns accounting. The card's original wording (a Reuters report on 2026-11-20 of an inquiry into accounting practices) is not confirmed as written
2026-11-25: Nvidia -8.7% in early trading: not confirmed at a primary or wire source

facts_as_first_written: 2026-11-20: Reuters report of SEC inquiry into Nvidia accounting, as cited by Schwab
Week of 2026-11-23: Huang's return as CEO reported; described as a 'temporary reprieve' (ABC/Reuters)
superseded_sources.summary_as_first_written: Reuters reported late on 2026-11-20 that the SEC is investigating Nvidia's accounting practices. Jensen Huang's sudden departure was reported the same week; his return as CEO was reported in the week of 2026-11-23.
